exact_statement: Let F be any finite genuine disjoint formula of Boolean gates with literal leaves, under any interior independent physical product law, with all gates evaluated at actual induced child laws and constants contracted. Let omega be the usual influence/child-variance weights, Delta=I-Var, R_tree=sum_v omega_v R(g_v), and E_1 the corrected singleton entropy in natural units. At each node define the actual singleton scale import T=T_out+T_in as in A043, and its imported mantissa refund V by replacing each singleton dyadic charge j ln4 in those two imports by ln(1/u^2), where 1/2<u=2^j|c|<=1. Then T,V>=0 and T+V+E_1(parent)=E_1(gate)+sum_i a_i E_1(child_i) exactly. Thus T_tot+V_tot+E_1(F)+S_tree=4Delta(F)-2R_tree, where S_tree=sum_v omega_v[4Delta(g_v)-2R(g_v)-E_1(g_v)]>=0. In particular the TOTAL singleton import satisfies T_tot<=4Delta(F)-2R_tree-E_1(F), uniformly in depth, fan-in and biases. This coefficient is not claimed sharp. Separately ln4 C_hi,tot+L_hi(F)=sum_v omega_v L_hi(g_v)+V_tot. With complete singleton-preserving paid-sector references and ordinary full KL, the signed flat/tree conversion is K_flat-K_tree=ln4 C_hi,tot-V_tot+n_F-sum_v omega_v n_v, retaining both full terminal laws and final singleton masses. No reference normalizer or imported refund is renewed. The universal arbitrary-prime high-degree scale J_hi remains unproved; the conditional composition FEI+ constant K+4+ln4 is unchanged.

exact_statement: For every genuine Boolean disjoint composition F=g(f_i) under an independent product law at the actual child-output biases, contract constants and set w_i=Var(f_i), a_i=I_i(g)/w_i, s_i=P_g({i}), b_i=(I_i(g)-s_i)/w_i, M_i=Delta_i-R_i. For dyadic upper-mantissa scales j, let T=ln4 sum_i s_i M_i j_g({i})/w_i+sum_i b_i J_1(f_i), zero singleton terms omitted. Then J_hi(F)=J_hi(g)+sum_i a_i J_hi(f_i)+ln4 C_hi+T, where C_hi is the actual high-label mantissa carry. Universally 0<=T<=ln4 Delta_F-(ln4/2)[R_g+sum_i((a_i-b_i)Delta_i+a_i R_i)]<=ln4 Delta_F. The outer-singleton import sub-bound T_out<=(ln4/2)sum_i a_i M_i is sharp on actual AND2 with parity/literal children. The combined constant is not claimed sharp. In the actual balanced ternary-majority tower F_d on 3^d fair bits, all dyadic carries and complete-reference normalizers/KLs vanish, Delta_d=(3/2)^d-1, and weighted accumulated import divided by ln4 is (3/2)Delta_d-d(3/4)^d. At d=4 it exceeds Delta_d by49/64, and its ratio to Delta_d tends to3/2. Thus the one-boundary ln4 allowance cannot be renewed as a depth-free total-import bank. No FEI disproof or universal prime-scale payment follows.
